phrase.en: rolling out now to all tiers

gloss.en: OpenAI's newest model claims to enter the AGI era, with both capability leaps and system-card caution.
gloss.zh: OpenAI 最新模型声称进入 AGI 时代，既有能力飞跃也有系统卡片警示。

why_now.en: You track LLM frontiers; today GPT-6 Astra rolls out, and independent tests show it solving ARC-AGI-3 while also taking a rare downtime.
why_now.zh: 你关注大模型前沿，今日 GPT-6 Astra 发布，独立测试显示其解决 ARC-AGI-3，但同时也出现罕见宕机。

phrase.en: free tool for home AI grid
phrase.zh: 免费工具构建家庭AI网格

phrase.en: cloud AI outage hits major models

gloss.en: Nvidia links idle home PCs into an AI data center while Qwen runs fast on Cerebras, and OpenAI's giant model still needs the cloud.
gloss.zh: 英伟达将闲置家用电脑组成 AI 数据中心，Qwen 在 Cerebras 上高速运行，而 OpenAI 的巨型模型仍需云端。

keyword.zh: AI 基础设施与本地计算

why_now.en: You care about embodied AI and practical systems: today Nvidia made personal AI clusters free, and an open model hit 1500 tokens/s, expanding local inference…
why_now.zh: 你关注具身AI和实用系统，今日英伟达免费提供个人AI集群，开源模型达到每秒1500 tokens，扩展本地推理选项。

phrase.en: asks Supreme Court to lift block
phrase.zh: 请求最高法院解除禁令

gloss.en: The U.S. Postal Service is at the center of a legal fight over restricting mail-in voting, with a judge warning of 'major disenfranchisement.'
gloss.zh: 美国邮政局成为限制邮寄投票法律斗争的中心，法官警告可能“大规模剥夺选举权”。

why_now.en: You follow civic tech and HCI-related policy: the Supreme Court is now asked to intervene, and a federal judge sees risks of valid ballots tossed.
why_now.zh: 你关注公民技术与人机交互相关政策，最高法院被要求介入，联邦法官认为有效选票可能被丢弃。

phrase.en: glamour was a means to an end
phrase.zh: 魅力是实现目标的工具

phrase.en: died peacefully surrounded by loved ones
phrase.zh: 在亲人陪伴下安详离世

phrase.en: found freedom from gender demands in later life
phrase.zh: 晚年摆脱性别要求束缚

gloss.en: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies at 92, prompting reflections on her life and the evolving meaning of gender.
gloss.zh: 女权主义偶像格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆去世，享年92岁，引发对她一生及性别意义演变的反思。

keyword.zh: 格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆遗产

why_now.en: You explore visual rhetoric and identity: Steinem's life shows how style and words craft social change; her death invites re-reading that craft.
why_now.zh: 你探索视觉修辞与身份认同，斯泰纳姆的一生展现风格与言辞如何塑造社会变革，她的去世促使重新解读这种技艺。

phrase.en: stock up for El Niño emergency
phrase.zh: 为厄尔尼诺紧急情况囤货

gloss.en: AI models like WeatherNext aim to predict extreme weather, while governments urge citizens to stock up for emergencies like El Niño.
gloss.zh: WeatherNext 等 AI 模型旨在预测极端天气，而政府敦促民众为厄尔尼诺等紧急情况囤货。

why_now.en: You connect AI to real-world impact: today's launch of Google's weather model and the UK's El Niño warning together highlight AI's role in disaster readiness.
why_now.zh: 你将AI与现实影响关联，今日谷歌天气模型发布与英国厄尔尼诺警告共同凸显AI在灾难应对中的作用。
